records.name: Kaelvar
records.summary: A northwestern continent of dry interior uplands, fertile southern coasts, and island-studded northern waters.

densityNotes: Southern coasts are high-density farming and port lands.
Western plateau is low-density frontier terrain.
Northern islands are settled but sparse.
populationProfile.settlementPattern: Southern kingdoms with sparse interior tribal and highland settlement.

civilizationNotes: Dwarven mountain networks anchor the western highlands.
Elves hold hidden river-valley and southern forest enclaves.
Orc tribes roam the dry interior plains.
strategicNotes: Kaelvar's interior is a natural conflict zone between settled southern powers and mobile tribal groups.

records.name: Valtherion
records.summary: The largest and most fertile landmass, dominated by major rivers, forested northlands, and vast agricultural basins.

densityNotes: Major river basins support dense cities and farm belts.
populationProfile.settlementPattern: Dense kingdoms and imperial river corridors with limited frontier margins.

civilizationNotes: Valtherion is the primary world civilization center.
Human kingdoms line the river basins.
Ancient elven forest realms dominate northern woodlands.
Dwarves inhabit mountain chains and canyon cities.
strategicNotes: Valtherion's border kingdoms and chokepoints make it the political center of the map.

records.name: Serathyl
records.summary: A long maritime continent of complex coasts, forested interiors, and merchant-friendly sea lanes.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Merchant republics and port federations linked by coastal shipping and inland valleys.

civilizationNotes: Human merchant republics line the coasts.

records.name: Draemor
records.summary: A fertile southern central continent defined by large river systems and powerful agricultural belts.

densityNotes: The central basin supports enormous food production.
populationProfile.settlementPattern: Large agrarian kingdoms and market towns fed by dense interior farming networks.

civilizationNotes: The central river basin supports enormous food production.
Large dwarven tunnel cities exist beneath the central hills.

records.name: Talmyra
records.summary: A wilder southeastern continent of tribal confederacies, volcanic strongholds, jungled interiors, and contested frontiers.

densityNotes: Interior jungle and mountain zones are very low-density.
populationProfile.settlementPattern: Fragmented tribal confederacies, fortified enclaves, and sparse frontier colonies.

civilizationNotes: Many tribal confederacies dominate the wilds.
Hidden elven enclaves survive in deep jungles.
Dwarven citadels stand in ancient volcanic ranges.
strategicNotes: Talmyra's frontier wars and spice trade shape southern sea politics.

records.name: The Auric Marches
records.summary: Golden plains, dry marches, and mineral-bearing uplands across western Kaelvar.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Sparse marches, mining outposts, and fortified routes.

records.name: Verdant Thalos
records.summary: The lush southern peninsula of Kaelvar, rich in agriculture, ports, and managed forests.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Dense farm belts and city-linked coasts.

records.name: The Shattercap Isles
records.summary: A broken northern island fringe that screens Kaelvar from the open northern sea.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Scattered fishing ports and lookout settlements.

records.name: The Crownlands
records.summary: Northern forests and highlands holding the oldest noble forests and elevated frontiers of Valtherion.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Forest realms, hill keeps, and headwater strongholds.

records.name: The Embersteppe
records.summary: A drier central plateau and steppe corridor between richer Valtherion basins.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Caravan routes, ranching corridors, and contested borderlands.

records.name: The Sapphire Rivers
records.summary: The eastern river basin of Valtherion, crowded with navigable waters, cities, and farmland.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Dense river cities, farmland, and administrative capitals.

records.name: The Jade Expanse
records.summary: A broad southern agricultural expanse where fertile lowlands feed the greater Valtherion system.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Heavy farming districts, market towns, and grain routes.

records.name: The Windward Spine
records.summary: The mountain backbone of Serathyl, shaping weather, travel, and northern settlement limits.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Sparse holds, passes, and upland communities.

records.name: The Green Reach
records.summary: The central forested heartland of Serathyl where timber, dyes, and elven domains overlap.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Forest towns, river clearings, and protected elven domains.

records.name: The Sailor's Verge
records.summary: An island-rich southern maritime rim of harbors, fleets, and sea-linked republics.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Dense port belts and island shipping towns.

records.name: The Heart Basin
records.summary: The core river hub and granary basin of Draemor.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Dense farm belts, river markets, and provisioning towns.

records.name: The Emerald Mantle
records.summary: The lowland belt surrounding Draemor's basin, rich in pasture, villages, and market roads.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Mixed farming districts and market-linked villages.

records.name: The Stormcap Coast
records.summary: The rough southern shores of Draemor where storms, fisheries, and hard ports dominate.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Hardy fishing ports and scattered coastal keeps.

records.name: The Thorn Peninsula
records.summary: The narrow southern extension of Talmyra, broken by peninsulas, cliffs, and exposed coasts.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Sparse coastal enclaves and fortified tribal settlements.

records.name: The Silver Valleys
records.summary: The more habitable interior valleys of Talmyra where rivers allow denser settlement and contested agriculture.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Contested valleys, fortified trade towns, and confederate seats.

records.name: The Watcher Coast
records.summary: An eastern coast of cliffs, islands, and hard maritime approaches along Talmyra's edge.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Sparse watch-forts, coves, and isolated island communities.

records.name: The Myridian Chain
records.summary: A busy archipelago between Kaelvar and Valtherion made up of pirate states, trade ports, and naval staging points.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Port towns, fortified islands, and freebooting harbor states.

records.name: The Lantern Isles
records.summary: Small central-ocean islands used as trade outposts, hidden anchorages, and pirate refuges.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Sparse outposts, relay ports, and hidden coves.

records.name: The Serpent's Wake
records.summary: A storm-lashed southern island arc infamous for pirate tribes, wrecking seas, and undersea kingdoms.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Dangerous anchorages, raider camps, and scattered hard ports.

notableGroups: Merfolk kingdoms beneath the surrounding waters

records.name: The Dawnreach Isles
records.summary: Sparse eastern islands far from the main continental centers, valuable mainly as waypoints and remote outposts.

populationProfile.settlementPattern: Remote outposts, seasonal camps, and isolated island communities.

records.name: The Azure Vast
records.summary: The central ocean binding the world map together through trade, piracy, and long-haul navigation.
strategicNotes: The Azure Vast is the main connective sea between all five continents.

records.name: The Gilded Sea
records.summary: A prosperous western sea adjacent to Valtherion and the northern island routes.
strategicNotes: This sea ties Valtherion to the Myridian routes and northwest exchanges.

records.name: The Tempest Expanse
records.summary: The storm-heavy southern ocean where climate and distance make navigation costly and dangerous.
strategicNotes: The Tempest Expanse amplifies the risks around southern islands and long ocean routes.

records.name: The Shattered Gulf
records.summary: A broken gulf between Serathyl and Draemor filled with sea lanes, island approaches, and contested shipping.
strategicNotes: The gulf is a natural maritime fault line between western merchants and southern grain routes.
